title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-17

ai_review.summary: Vivid audience recording of a sun‑splashed Ventura show, delivering a high‑energy first set with standout Truckin', Tennessee Jed and a swirling China Cat > I Know You Rider, captured in clear AUD sound.
ai_review.review: The tape captures the breezy, beachside vibe of the Ventura shows with surprisingly clean audience recording that lets the crowd ambience shine through. Musically the band fires on all cylinders early – a smoking first‑set close with Truckin', tight Tennessee Jed and a mesmerizing China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider – though some reviewers note a dip in steam during the second set. Jerry’s nuanced chord work and Bob’s vocal variations add extra sparkle, while Phil’s bass provokes mixed reactions.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars and praise the performance and clear audience recording; only a few note minor dips, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough to hear details; captures ocean breeze and crowd ambience; described as 'wonderful sounding AUD' with no major drop‑outs noted.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, tight first set that some feel loses a bit of steam in the second; overall flow remains engaging with memorable transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for nuanced chord soloing in Rider and great playing on The Wheel; guitar work described as fine‑tuned and expressive.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mixed feedback – praised by some for bass power, but criticized by others for odd, over‑playing that disrupted cohesion later in the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for throwing different vocal lines in Reprise and Around, adding variety to the performance.
